sn45.49:1.1: sāvatthinidānaṁ sūriyassa → sāvatthīnidānaṁ suriyassa (sya-all); sāvatthinidānam suriyassa (pts)
sn45.49:1.2: sūriyassa → suriyassa (bj) | aruṇuggaṁ → aruṇaggaṁ (bj) | aruṇaggaṁ → aruṇuggaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā) | aruṇuggaṁ → S1-3 arunaggaṁ always. (pts note)
sn45.49:1.4: bahulīkarissati → bahulīkarissatīti (sya-all) | bhāvessati → S1-3 bhāvissati. (pts note) | bahulīkarissati → B1 -karissatī ti. (pts note)
sn45.49:1.7: kalyāṇamitto ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ → kalyānamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam (pts)
